texts.arguments: For facility of reference, rule 3.3.4 reads as under:- "A certified copy of every order passed by the Appellate Tribunal shall be communicated to the Adjudicating Officer and to the parties, as the case may be." Managing Director M/S Wani Brothers vs Ut Of J&K on 2 December, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/166206534/ 1 It is a beaten principle of law that if a law prescribes a particular thing/action to be done in a particular manner/mode, then any departure/deviation therefrom shall not result in any prejudice to a person visiting him with civil consequences. Learned counsel applicant relies upon the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in case titled "Collector of Central Excise, Madras Vs M. M. Rubber and Co. Tamil Nadu," reported in AIR 1991 SC 2141, which in clear terms deals with the import and importance of communication of adjudicatory orders/quasi judicial orders to the litigants.
